name: triple-convert
unmodelled: Two conversions per hit (Physical to Fire to Chaos) and the damage history: the engine does not model conversion inside a hit; only scorch-fist converts (half to Fire). The identity piece Former Shapes is approximated as a flat +20 L5, one link's worth, not +20 per earlier type
Kindled Wound scopes to Fire parts and Festering Wound to Chaos parts: mod keys have no part scope, so Kindled Wound is a flat L5 +15 against Burn and Festering Wound is omitted
Fire to Chaos convert_pct (Green-Smoke Sutra +50, Kiln-Hook Sword +30, tree) and Chaos penetration +80: no conversion field or typed penetration for them; not written
Sundered curse (curses takes only withering and stagnation): the library arts bring their own statuses instead
Kiln-Hook Sword Blood Drinker 6 % leech, Nine Rods Array and Soot Coating L4: L4 stands as a flat 80, leech omitted

Layers, crit, ward and cost reduction are not from an old fight file (none existed for this build): taken from the guide's caps and the typical Nguyen Anh anchor, L2 left empty because the invented canon passives are gone and library passives load as tech effects
Spiritual root purity 75 each in metal, fire, wood: the guide says 70 or more
